shadow-pact.summary: A bargain with the Shadowfell: darker sight, steadier healing in shadow and a cloak of dim light.

Darkvision.summary: Darkvision 60 ft, or +30 ft if you already have it.

Shadow Blood.summary: While wholly in Dim Light or Darkness, reroll any 1 on a healing die and keep the new roll.

Shroud of Shadows.summary: Bonus Action: give off a 5-ft Emanation of Dim Light for 1 minute; dismiss it freely, and it ends if you're Incapacitated. Once per Short or Long Rest.

shadow-trapper.summary: A shadow-hunter who strikes true inside their Shroud and fills grappled foes with sorrow.

Dangerous Shroud.summary: Advantage on attack rolls against creatures inside your Shroud of Shadows.

Sorrowful Embrace.summary: A creature you have Grappled makes a WIS save at the start of its turn (DC 8 + PB + the ability you raised) or takes 1d4 + that ability's modifier in Psychic damage.

shadow-weaver.summary: A shadow-shaper who conjures Darkness and reshapes or moves it at will.

Create Shadow.summary: Darkness is always prepared; once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. The ability you raised casts it.

Manipulate Shadow.summary: Bonus Action: grow or shrink the radius of your Darkness by 5 ft (5–25 ft), or shift it to a spot within 60 ft.
